`edge0-long-prompt.txt` is the exact output (without an added newline) of `_long_prompt()` in Edge0 commit `c7ee73d5dfb3729de452bdb1fec7df7aebe42806`, `python/examples/bench.py`. Source: https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Edge0/blob/c7ee73d5dfb3729de452bdb1fec7df7aebe42806/python/examples/bench.py

`library-report-prompt.txt` is an original, non-repetitive Chinese document (a survey report on renovating a community library) followed by three questions; it was written for this repository. With the 35B chat template it is 3,084 input tokens, above the default `prefill_ahead_min_tokens` of 3,000, so the default `prefill_read=auto` uses `ahead`. Use it for demonstrations and for checks where repeated text could make expert usage unrealistically concentrated.

`library-report-prompt-head.txt` is the opening of `library-report-prompt.txt` (616 tokens of the same natural text, 627 with the 35B chat template). It is the default input for everyday checks, measurements and demonstrations, especially on slow platforms such as Android CPU, where prefill runs at about 20-30 tokens per second. Use the full `library-report-prompt.txt` only when the long input itself is under test (for example the `prefill_read=auto` threshold) or when comparing with stored Mac baselines.
